modules.gap_reason: No gap in the renderer itself: Blender is installed and drives the imaging path. It cannot be imported into the venv (no Windows/py3.12 bpy wheel), so it is driven as an external process with a frozen JSON contract. Measured limits of the Blender 5.2.2 pass set are recorded instead of hidden: the Cycles Material Index pass returns a constant 0 and the Z / Object Index passes are not filter-averaged, so per-face labels are published through Shader AOVs and the delivered integer channels come from a one-sample exact geometry pass (docs/a12/blender_backend.md).
